tagline: One calm ledger for every space in your life.

landing.support: Clear Money keeps personal, household, and shared ledgers calm, private, and in one place.
landing.privacyBody: Your ledger stays yours. No ad targeting, no selling your history.
landing.pricingPreviewBody: Start free with a personal space, one shared invite, and safe-to-spend on Home. Plus adds OCR, extra capacity, and AI volume later.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Grow when your spaces do.
pricing.hidden: Billing is currently disabled for this build.

setup.welcomeBody: A calm premium tracker for every money space you keep.
setup.languageBody: We’ll coach you in the language you choose — change it anytime.
setup.meetBody: I’m your Clear Money guide — a little coin with a map sense for where your money goes. Let’s set things up together.
setup.featuresBody: Swipe through the highlights, then we’ll finish your preferences.

features.ledgerBody: Capture income and spending in seconds — clear totals, no spreadsheet stress.
features.spacesBody: Personal, shared, or project money — each with its own picture.
features.aiBody: Ask in plain language. Get answers without leaving your flow.

setup.currencyBody: Amounts and reports will default to this. You can still log other currencies later.
setup.notificationsBody: Optional daily facts and weekly reviews — never spammy, always yours to turn off.
setup.notificationsBenefit: Stay gently aware of spending without opening the app every day.
setup.readyBody: Create an account to sync across devices, or jump straight into the demo.
setup.introBody: Create an account to sync, or explore the demo ledger right away.

bubbles.language: Hi! First things first — which language feels natural?
bubbles.meet: Nice to meet you. I’m Penny. I’ll stick with you through setup.
bubbles.features: Quick tour: ledger, spaces, and a helpful AI sidekick.
bubbles.currency: What should we call “home base” for your money?
bubbles.notifications: Want a soft nudge now and then? Totally optional.
bubbles.ready: Boom — you’re ready. I’ll cheer from the sidelines.

ai.title: Penny
ai.subtitle: Say it, type it, or tap a chip — I'll file it without the lecture.
ai.welcome: Hey — I'm Penny. Hit me with a spend, a payday, or "how am I doing?" I'll keep the jokes light and the ledger honest.
ai.categoryPlaceholder: Pick a category or type one…
ai.savedQuip: Parked in the ledger before it can escape.
ai.askNote: Want a short note on that? Totally optional.
ai.noteSkipped: No note, no problem — it's already saved.
ai.noteThanks: Note locked in. Your future self says thanks.
